To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
induced soft gluon brembstrahlung is suppressed in a hot medium, and that the induced radiation is approximately isotropic in the medium frame.

a systematic study of the radiation spectrum of a fast parton in a QCD medium.
the development of a perturbative QFT approach for calculating the induced gluon bremsstralung in a QCD medium.

the following three aspects of the problem of energy loss of a high-energy parton propagating through a dense medium: the formation of the gluon radiation, its energy loss and the multiple scattering of a parton.

the induced soft gluon bremssstrahlung in the multiple scattering regime is dominated by the Landau-Pomeanchuk effect.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the induced soft gluon brembstrahlung is suppressed in the medium with respect to the free propagation case by an amount of the order of ( μ / Q ) 2, where Q ∼ 1 / τ f is the characteristic momentum scale associated with the formation time τ f of the jet partons.
the radiation formation time, rather than the jet formation time, controls the suppression of induced radiation.
the radiation formation factor can be used to describe the dependence of the radiative energy loss on the kinematic variables of the jet and on the representation of the jet quark or gluon.
